cleanTraceBeforePatch.finding: Without CPU-profiler tracing overhead, the remaining long tasks were React scheduler chunks around performWorkUntilDeadline. Paint/layout were smaller than the React scheduled work.

change.summary: Moved tutorial thumbnail viewport observation from one IntersectionObserver per video thumbnail to one grid-level IntersectionObserver with batched viewport-map updates. Children now receive near/visible-poster booleans instead of owning observer effects.

conclusion: The single-observer pass reduced React scheduling overhead and improved p95/max frame timing. Occasional long frames remain, so the broader latency goal is still active.
